title: BC Friday Tips #45 Hide Agents Icon
summary: Business Central now displays an Agents icon in the Role Center navigation menu. You can hide this icon by deactivating Agents in Copilot & agent capabilities settings, which helps keep the UI clean and prevents confusion for users not using AI Agents yet.
key_points: An Agents icon appears in the Role Center navigation menu at the top right
You can hide the Agents icon by going to Copilot & agent capabilities and deactivating Agents
Hiding the icon keeps the UI clean and reduces confusion for users not yet using AI Agents

quotes.text: You'll notice the Agents icon at the top right of your Role Center navigation menu.
quotes.why_it_matters: Helps users locate the new Agents feature in their interface
